_comment: Team members who use the CV tool - this is the 'Your name' picker in the app, i.e. who SENDS a CV. It is a separate list from the heads who RECEIVE every CV (CV_RECIPIENTS in mailer.py). Someone can be on both. The app sends from one shared mailbox, but each email is labelled with the member's name and carries their address as Reply-To, so a head replying reaches the right person. Add or remove entries here and restart api.py - no code change needed.
